enabled.description: Enable or disable road generation globally

vegetationAllowedOnRoad.description: Whether vegetation can grow on road surface blocks

minVegetationDistanceFromRoad.description: Minimum distance in blocks between road edge and vegetation

voronoiCellSize.description: Spacing between road waypoints in blocks (controls road network density)

displacementScale.description: Max displacement in blocks for road curvature (0 = perfectly straight)

displacementFrequency.description: Noise frequency for road curvature (higher = more wiggly)

defaultRoad.description: Default road config used for biomes not listed in biomes map

biomes.description: Per-biome road config overrides keyed by biome id

surface.description: Block type used as road surface

roadProbability.description: Probability [0,1] that a Voronoi edge becomes a road in this biome (checked at edge center). 1.0 = always, 0.0 = never.
